title: •Senator Leia Organa
caption: •Princess Organa (V)
heading: •Senator Leia Organa (V)
game_text_lines:
*Agendas*: justice, rebellion. When deployed, may
play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting
Effect (as if from hand). While aboard Alderaan
Consular Ship, it is immune to Lateral Damage
and attrition. Attrition against opponent is +2 here.
lore: Adopted by Bail Organa. Former senator of Alderaan. Natural *leader*. Helped steal the Death Star plans. A key figure in the Rebel Alliance.

notes: Group: Rebel Senate. COMBO / FULL-CARD OVERLAY (755×1101) on the silver Light character frame. Title bar: Rebel disc + ROUND silver Republic crest → 'Rebel + Republic' (printed Princess Organa: Rebel disc only); title '•Senator Leia Organa'; destiny 2 (printed: 1). LORE PRINTED ON THE SLIP, same wording as the printed card but with 'leader' in BOLD (clearly visible on the slip; line breaks differ: slip 'Adopted by Bail Organa. Former senator of Alderaan. Natural / leader. Helped steal the Death Star plans. A key figure in / the Rebel Alliance.'); the 350 px base scan shows 'leader' plain, so the bold is the slip's. The VB4 reissue prints 'Death Star Plans' (capital P) — the slip has lower-case 'plans'. Ring: Special Edition only (no Episode I), as printed → no ring_icons. Art blank. Stats POWER 3 / ABILITY 3 / POLITICS 1 (printed: FORCE-ATTUNED); deploy 3 (unchanged) / forfeit 5 (printed 7); column: warrior only (printed: pilot + warrior); VS16 sphere. 'Agendas' bold, the colon NOT bold. Slip text matches the stub. Base lore matches the wiki. Base scan 350 px; SE copyright line legible.
